description: FREE ($0.000, no API key required) pre-purchase 2-phase handshake & inventory check across all 16 STRATA/TrashPan B2A streams. Returns whether a target domain, company ATS job board, trend keyword, Japanese public dataset, POI location, OLIPAI TCG SKU, academic R&D paper, ANSR Golf EV/SG profile matrix, or 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number reputation record is in stock, its SHA-256 fingerprint, 24h freshness, and instant x402 / Apify purchase links. Unindexed queries are automatically queued into AIGREED for auto-restock.

amendmentsOnly.description: When true in mode="edinet_gc_amendments", probes amended securities/quarterly/semi-annual reports.

boardSlug.description: Company ATS board slug when probing ats-jobs (e.g. "stripe", "layerx").

companyScale.description: Company scale ("large", "sme", or "micro") when probing mode="gov_qualification".

corporateNumber.description: 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number (NTA Mod-9 validated, e.g. "1180301018771") when probing jp-entity-reputation or KYB/tenders/patent streams.

corporateNumbers.description: Batch of 13-digit Japanese Corporate Numbers (1 to 1,000).

docId.description: 8-character EDINET filing document ID (e.g. "S100ABCD") when probing mode="edinet_gc_amendments".

domain.description: Domain name to check when probing domain-lookup (e.g. "nttdata.com", "preferred.jp").

edinetCode.description: 6-character FSA EDINET submitter code (e.g. "E02144") when probing mode="edinet_gc_amendments" or jp-edinet-financial-macro-feed.

entityName.description: Organization or corporate legal name when probing jp-entity-reputation with mode="ofac_sanctions".

goingConcernOnly.description: When true in mode="edinet_gc_amendments", probes filings with statutory Going Concern notes or material events.

hasBicOnly.description: When true in mode="gleif_lei", filters for entities with SWIFT BIC codes.

holeNumber.description: Optional golf hole number (1-18) when probing ansr-golf-ev-engine.

keyword.description: Search keyword when probing google-trends or Japanese public data streams.

lapsedOnly.description: When true in mode="gleif_lei", filters for LAPSED LEI registrations.

lei.description: 20-character ISO 17442 LEI (Mod 97-10 validated, e.g. "5493006W3QUS5LMH6R84") when probing jp-entity-reputation with mode="gleif_lei".

minQualificationGrade.description: Minimum Unified Government Qualification grade ("A" highest through "D").

mode.description: Mode when probing jp-entity-reputation ("lookup", "screen", "gleif_lei", "ofac_sanctions", "gov_qualification", or "edinet_gc_amendments") or ansr-golf-ev-engine.

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture name or 2-digit JIS code (e.g. "東京都", "13").

qualificationGrade.description: Exact Unified Government Qualification grade ("A", "B", "C", or "D") when probing mode="gov_qualification".

query.description: Facility/station/golf-course query string when probing POI or ANSR golf streams.

secCode.description: 4- or 5-digit Japanese securities code when probing jp-edinet-financial-macro-feed.

streamId.description: Target B2A stream ID to probe (e.g. domain-lookup, ats-jobs, google-trends, jp-company-kyb-registry-delta, ansr-golf-ev-engine, jp-places-poi-geospatial-intel, olipai-jp-tcg-collectibles-market, jp-academic-rnd-patent-citation-feed, jp-entity-reputation).

walletAddress.description: Blockchain wallet address (e.g. "0x...", "TNiq9AXBp9EjUqhDhrwrfvAA8U3GUQZH81") when probing jp-entity-reputation with mode="ofac_sanctions".

walletAddresses.description: Batch of blockchain wallet addresses for OFAC organizational sanctions screening.
